jobs.name: daily-pr-review

payload.message: Daily PR Code Review. jobs.name: b2b-reply-scanner-1h
jobs.description: Scan Gmail for B2B prospect replies every hour

payload.message:
Scan Gmail (a@muso.ai) for new B2B Ads outreach replies in the last 65 minutes. Use gog to check recent inbox. Filter for replies from B2B prospects we have emailed (cross-reference with the B2B outreach sheet). IGNORE all internal emails (from muso.ai domains), SaaS notifications, marketing emails, and anything that is not a direct reply from a B2B prospect.

CRITICAL SILENCE RULE: If there are NO new B2B prospect replies, your ENTIRE response must be empty — literally produce no output at all. Do not say NO_REPLY, do not say "nothing found", do not summarize. Just stop. Fede does not want to see any message when there is nothing to report.

Only if you find an actual B2B prospect reply, format your response with: sender name, company, reply summary, and suggested next action. Also sync GHL pipeline stage if applicable (move to Replied or Meeting Booked).

Run the AMP Daily Report. Query core-backend tables public_ad_events and public_ads via Athena (workgroup: clio-agent, region: us-west-2). Build report: 1) Summary: all-time/7d/today views, clicks, CTR, unique viewers with deltas. 2) Top 5 ads by CTR. 3) Underperformers (CTR < 0.3% with >1K views). 4) AMP vs Feed breakdown. 5) Platform breakdown. 6) Daily trend 7 days. Format for Slack bullets, keep short.

jobs.name: daily-dev-activity-report

payload.message: Run the daily dev activity report. For each developer (adk47=Aaron, liflovs=Serhii), run the dev-report.sh script or use gh CLI to get commits from the last 24h across all Muso-AI repos (core-backend, web-credits, platform-data-processing, industry-data-processing, analytics-worker, mobile, devops, feed-service, customer-api-mcp, render-service, web-encore).
